evidence.quote: Piotr Janusz Krupa Partner and Portfolio Manager Piotr joined Trinity Street in 2015 as an Investment Analyst and became a Junior Portfolio Manager in 2020. In April 2025, Piotr was promoted to Portfolio Manager. Prior to Trinity Street, he spent two years at Goldman Sachs in London as an Analyst on the Emerging Markets desk within the FICC (Fixed Income, Currency and Commodities) division. Piotr holds an MPhil in Finance and Economics and a BA in Economics, both from the University of Cambridge (Trinity College).
